question: A 435-metre-long train crosses a platform thrice its length in 87 seconds. What is the speed of the train (in km/hr)?
solution:
**Given:**

Train length = 435 m

Platform length = 3 × 435 m

Time = 87 s

**Formula used:**

Speed = Total Distance / Time

Total Distance = Train length + Platform length

Speed (km/hr) = Speed (m/s) × 18/5

**Calculation:**

Total Distance = 435 + (3 × 435)

⇒ 435 + 1305 = 1740 m

Speed = 1740 / 87

⇒ 20 m/s

Speed in km/hr = 20 × 18/5

⇒ 4 × 18 = 72 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
